user_facing_name: joint parameter and process-noise switching without truth-state clipping
scientific_question: When the true parameter candidate and the true lower-groundwater process-noise level switch simultaneously at known stage boundaries while all fifteen truth-state values remain continuous and unprojected, does the fully interacting nine-candidate bank keep parameter-margin identification undegraded, and does noise-margin identification follow the single-factor pattern?
scope: assimilation-only warm-wet synthetic HBV-lite joint switch confirmation; no forecast

version_history.note: v04 changes nothing that can affect the truth, the filtering, the margin rules or the visual-review protocol; every seed, candidate, schedule, rule threshold and display-order seed is copied literally from v03, so the run is bit-identical by construction
version_history.v01: frozen and run: the aligned rotation placed high process noise on fast-draining candidate_3 (median lower-groundwater storage 33 mm); the truth projection gate failed on all 24 trajectories, zero output, formal seeds unconsumed
version_history.v02: frozen and run: high noise moved to candidate_1, but stage inheritance carried 19 to 36 mm of lower-groundwater storage across the boundary into candidate_1 stages whose recovery time constant is about 175 days; the gate failed after the boundary, zero output, formal seeds unconsumed
version_history.v03: frozen and run to completion: physical gates passed (zero truth projections over 12960 transitions, zero boundary projections, probability normalisation error 3.33e-16, 48 switch events), blinded visual review collected and sealed; the run itself is sound and its independent verification reproduced every truth and margin array to 0.0 absolute difference, but the v03 independent verifier could never report success because three declarative entries ('production experiment module imported', 'production runner imported', 'forecast module imported') carried the value false to mean 'correctly not imported' while the verdict aggregator required every entry to be true; the defect made the verifier structurally incapable of passing and it had never surfaced because v01 and v02 produced no output to verify
version_history.v04: re-freeze after repairing that verifier: the three entries are renamed to positive polarity ('..._not_imported'), their values are now measured from sys.modules instead of hard-coded, the aggregator rejects any non-boolean entry, and the repaired verifier is recorded in this run's source manifest so the source-hash chain stays intact

parameter_source.note: the three shared-state-domain parameter candidates are copied literally from the sealed parameter-switch confirmation config

truth_trial_stage_orders.note: aligned rotations re-paired in v03: high noise is permanently paired with candidate_2 stages (fast recovery time constant about 45 days, equilibrium lower-groundwater storage about 452 mm), fast-draining candidate_3 is permanently paired with low noise (exactly the combination already verified projection-free in the sealed parameter-switch confirmation), and candidate_1 is permanently paired with medium noise; v01 placed high noise on candidate_3 (median lower-groundwater storage 33 mm) and correctly failed the truth projection gate with zero output; v02 moved high noise to candidate_1 but stage inheritance carried low storage (19 to 36 mm) across the boundary into candidate_1 stages whose recovery time constant is about 175 days, so it also failed the gate after the boundary with zero output; the v03 pairing passed the truth feasibility check with zero projections on all eight formal forcing seeds and all three rotations before this freeze, and the truth depends only on the frozen seeds, so the formal-run physical gate outcome is deterministic; 3 of 9 direction pairings covered, each margin direction 16 events, unchanged from v01

filter.global_posterior_output: posterior-probability-weighted fifteen-state state and covariance after every update

parameter_margin_response_rule.margin_definition: posterior probability summed over the three process-noise levels for each parameter candidate

noise_margin_response_rule.margin_definition: posterior probability summed over the three parameter candidates for each process-noise level

lower_groundwater_low_to_lower_groundwat.reason: discharge-channel information limit: medium footprint 0.0885 mm/day is half the 0.1780 mm/day observation noise; likelihood-only upper bound needs 46 days, beyond the 30-day window
lower_groundwater_low_to_lower_groundwat.consequence: reported verbatim; its failure does not count as method failure and does not trigger a stop

joint_unique_combination_readout.note: descriptive only: top-ranked fraction and takeover timing of the true (parameter, noise) pair; no pass/fail gate because the noise-channel information limit would make any 30-day joint-uniqueness gate a predictable failure

visual_review_rule.clear_success_definition: the new true candidate margin forms sustained visibly separated dominance after the switch and was not already persistently dominant before the switch
visual_review_rule.final_event_success_definition: per margin: numerical_success and visual_label equals clear_success
